change.after: "SHA-384 for 3072-bit RSA keys, SHA-512 for 4096-bit RSA keys"

original.statement: RSA certificates with 3072- or 4096-bit keys are now signed with SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively, which may cause errors with peers that don't support these hashes as keys rotate.

corrected.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, RSA certificates with 3072-bit keys now use SHA-384 as the hash algorithm, and those with 4096-bit keys now use SHA-512.

decision.reason: [ev-463f236bf567] says RSA certificates with 3072- or 4096-bit keys will now use SHA-384 or SHA-512 as hash algorithms. That is the same configuration with different semantics, so behavior-changed is the right type. The proposed name adds "signature", which does not appear in the evidence, so the name is rebuilt from the evidence's own words as "rsa-hash-algorithm". The proposed "after" value is a paraphrase wrapped in extra quotes, not a literal value from the text; "after" is optional for behavior-changed, so it is left out.
